description: Defines the backend_worker class responsible for running a secondary thread that processes log entries from a work queue and dispatches them to sinks. Includes thread management, error handling, and queue monitoring.

classes.name: backend_worker
classes.description: Manages a secondary thread that processes log entries from a queue and dispatches them to sinks, with thread control and error handling.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the backend worker thread with specified priority.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the backend worker thread if it is running.

methods.name: is_running
methods.description: Returns whether the worker thread is currently running.

methods.name: set_error_handler
methods.description: Sets a custom error handler for error notifications, ignored if the worker is running.

methods.name: create_worker
methods.description: Creates the worker thread with specified priority.

methods.name: do_work
methods.description: Entry function executed by the worker thread to process log entries.

methods.name: process_outstanding_entries
methods.description: Processes remaining entries in the queue until empty.

methods.name: report_queue_on_full_once
methods.description: Reports a warning if the queue is nearly full, only once.

methods.name: set_thread_priority
methods.description: Sets the thread priority for the worker thread.
